snippet.description:
🏆𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝘾𝙡𝙤𝙨𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙁𝙞𝙡𝙢 𝙤𝙛 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝟯𝟬𝙩𝙝 𝘽𝙄𝙁𝙁

제30회 부산국제영화제 폐막작으로 부산 어워드 대상 수상작인 장률 감독의 루오무의 황혼이 선정되었습니다.✨

아시아의 거장 장률 감독의 루오무의 황혼은 중국의 작은 도시를 배경으로 옛 연인을 좇는 여인의 여정을 따뜻한 시선과 유머로 그려낸 작품입니다.

Gloaming in Luomu by director ZHANG Lu has been selected as the Closing Film of the 30th Busan International Film Festival (BIFF) and winner of the Busan Award Best Film. 

Regarded as one of Asia's most prominent auteurs, ZHANG Lu presents Gloaming in Luomu, a warm and humorous tale of a woman's journey through a small Chinese town in search of a long-lost lover.

I’m still in San Francisco waiting for a flight back.  
Regretfully, I cannot meet you all in person.  
I really wanted to meet my idol, Director Lee Chang-dong, and hold a talk,  
but sadly, that’s not possible now.
I would like to thank the Busan International Film Festival for screening my film Election again,  
and also thank the audience for watching my work.  
I hope to return to Busan soon to meet all of you.  

Thank you very much.

I hope to return to Busan soon to meet all of you.  

Thank you very much.
